name: hooks
description: Open source hooks library for AI coding agents. Storage is a data-backend switch, never a deployment mode: local SQLite at ~/.hasna/hooks/hooks.db by default, or PostgreSQL when HASNA_HOOKS_DATABASE_URL is set with HASNA_HOOKS_STORAGE_BACKEND=postgresql. The retired HASNA_HOOKS_STORAGE_MODE / HOOKS_STORAGE_MODE deployment-mode variables are read as errors, not no-ops. MCP is served by the `hooks mcp` subcommand (no separate mcp bin).

serviceSurfaces.name: serve
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: The monorepo four-surface law requires a -serve server bin, and `hooks serve` does not exist on main. It is in flight in lane L1 of the hooks unification (todos cfbd9c0d-63b7-41d3-bd3c-fc0b9fa67864). Flip this surface to supported and add the bin when it lands.
